title: What will improve the gesture model?
instruction: The gesture model gets confused with your friends. Mark everything that will help.
debrief: A model learns only from what it has seen. More varied, balanced training data and a test on new people make it better.

items.why: The model will see that people wave in different ways.

items.text: Add examples with both the left and the right hand
items.why: What is missing from the data, the model can’t do.

items.text: Train longer on the same ten examples
items.why: It still sees only you. It won’t learn new patterns from them.
More varied data, so the model doesn’t learn only your pace.
A name shows the model nothing new.

items.text: Test on people the model has never seen
items.why: Only a test on new data shows whether the model really works.
